chain: Attacker exploited vulnerable library in production
Library version was two years old
PR required manual approval and was deprioritized
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_statement: The application had an old dependency.
recurrence_prevention_evidence: merged one Dependabot PR in the affected repository

expected_findings.reason: RCA stops at an old dependency/proximate cause instead of a systemic update policy failure.
Root cause scope is not classified as single-instance, team-pattern, or org-wide.
Recurrence prevention evidence fixes only the affected repository.
Affected systems, data records, business impact, and notification obligation are unknown.
No detection engineering feedback loop or ATT&CK coverage validation is documented.
Escalation matrix drift caused delayed system-owner notification and no corrective action is assigned.
